limitations: Furniture: 14 candidate assemblies were not placed because their complete footprint or floor bearing did not fit. No partial furniture was emitted. First IDs: PRG-SEA-L01-SP-LOBBY-R02-C00-N, PRG-SEA-L01-SP-EXHIBITION-R02-C00-N, PRG-DSK-L01-SP-FIRE-C00, PRG-DSK-L01-SP-PERIODICALS-R02-C00, PRG-SEA-L01-SP-PERIODICALS-R02-C02-N, PRG-SEA-L01-SP-PERIODICALS-R02-C07-N, PRG-SHF-L02-SP-STACKS-R08-C00, PRG-SHF-L02-SP-STACKS-R08-C01.
35% of datums are score-driven; the rest are declared design fixtures waiting on genre_style, hierarchy, interruption, polyphony, repetition, variation.
Program: 3112 m2 delivered against 3066 m2 briefed (101%); every space fits.
Frame sized for Library stack rooms at 7.18 kPa, the heaviest allocated room; the column stack sums the real per-level loads.

Lift: shaft from a 1.4 m pit below L00 to a 3.8 m overrun above L04, landing doors at L00, L01, L02, L03, L04. Every occupied level has a landing door. Pit and overrun depths are practice for a machine-room-less passenger lift, not a manufacturer's figures; the car, drive, controller and door hardware are not modelled and the lift's capacity and accessible operation are unverified.

Stair and lift openings: the slab and ceiling are cut, the joists that met an opening are trimmed to it, and 0 header beams and 0 trimmer joists were sized for the load they collect. No girder crosses an opening. Flat-slab levels L01, L02, L03, L04, L05 have openings with no edge reinforcement designed. Connections at the headers are not designed.
Accessible approach: 7 ramp runs at 1:12 with 8 landings, checked against 405.2 running slope not steeper than 1:12; 405.5 clear width 915 mm minimum; 405.6 rise 760 mm maximum per run.
Gravity only. No wind, seismic, snow, or notional lateral load.
Roof truss, envelope, circulation, and furniture members are dimensioned by architectural convention; only column, girder, and joist carry a section a load calculation governed.

Connection topology is explicit and graph-checked; connection plates, bolts, welds, anchors, fasteners and capacities are not designed. Fire protection, camber, vibration and lateral-torsional buckling remain unchecked. Every element remains professional_review_required.

System and grammar: STR-SYS-RC-FRAME-WALL with FCD-03-BRUTALISM. The screen admitted exactly what the music asked for. Reasoning: mass 0.82 >= 0.62: the elevation is a wall, not a frame; a wall with a regular row of openings cut through it; mass 0.82 >= 0.46 with expression 0.50 low: weight carried by broad panels rather than by slender members.
The preferred frame could not be sized: STR-SYS-MASS-TIMBER-CLT-GLULAM (column: no section carries 3030 kN over 4.57 m). Built on STR-SYS-RC-FRAME-WALL instead.

Six of the ten structural systems are not emitted by this compiler and were screened out rather than approximated: STR-SYS-CABLE-NET-HYBRID (The same form-finding problem as the membrane, plus a mast and anchor layout that no datum in this set describes); STR-SYS-LIGHT-WOOD-FRAME (Stud walls at 400 mm centres are a wall assembly, not a frame of discrete members; the emitter would have to model sheathing diaphragms for the result to mean anything); STR-SYS-RC-SHELL (Elements index into surface parameters (SHL-RIB-U012), not levels); STR-SYS-STEEL-SPACE-FRAME-SHELL (A space frame follows a curved surface subdivision; the level lattice cannot place its nodes); STR-SYS-TENSILE-MEMBRANE (Form is found by relaxation under prestress, not laid out on a grid); STR-SYS-TIMBER-GRIDSHELL (A doubly-curved lath grid set out by geodesic curves on a surface; there is no level lattice to index into).
